Maeda Toshiie comes to the heroes on Onigashima to report a strange incident that occurred in his homeland, [Ogoya Mines].
What exactly has happened in Kaga, where humans and yokai coexist?

During the event period, the NPC [Maeda Toshiie]will appear in front of the Statue on Onigashima.
By speaking with him, you can progress through the event quests.

※To accept this event quest, you must have cleared the main quest [Rescuing Lady Shizuka and Yoshitsune].

※Please be sure to use Summoning Scrolls prior to entering a Dungeon in order to be eligible for the Bonus.
※Please clear the dungeon with the target accessories equipped.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a19a3f504b564c12ab666d4f4106c55baf47bb0b.jpg

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 9/11/2025 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue where the player’s sword skill [Ougi Thorn Season Six String Slam -V] would not activate.

・Fixed an issue where the skill [Ougi Backstep Shoot - Sublime] would sometimes hit the ground when used against certain monsters.
To address this issue, the bullet speed and homing performance have been adjusted.

・Implemented a temporary fix for an issue where NPC Yoshitsune’s Weapon Smithing would not unlock under certain conditions.
　This issue occurred when the recipe for Oninodachi was given to the specially-appearing NPC [Yoshitsune] in the field Oushuu Highway.
　After the update, if this issue has occurred, the quest [Crafting the Oninodachi] will appear at NPC [Yoshitsune] to unlock Weapon Smithing.

・Other minor issues have been fixed.

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

The limited-time characters will return in two parts: first half and second half!
In the second half, Fuuma Kotarou and Genbu will appear!

----------------------------------------------------------------

New Nyankoropon details can be found here.
*Japanese language only

◆Nyankoropon Period
　From maintenance 9/4/2025 JST
　Until maintenance 9/18/2025 JST

[hr][/hr]
・Gargoyle Weapons Reborn！
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8d9b496a582cb03a6f6b9cb4c0930b7b88678bb0.jpg

The weapons that can be crafted from Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Purgatorium-, Assault!Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-, Assault!Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium- Void Series are being reborn!
They can now be enhanced into the more powerful Void -Strike- Series, equipped with stronger Desperate abilities.

Be sure to check out the new strategies, such as secret skills that inflict status ailments useful when HP decreases, and options that make follow-up attacks more likely to occur the lower your HP gets!

Furthermore, the Void -Strike- Series is also coming to Magatama!
Recipes will be added to the Exchange Shop before the Great Calamity Purge along with the weapons.

Additionally, Skill Cards for the new skills granted to the Void -Strike- Series—Flame Pillar Blast, Ice Pillar Blast, Lightning Pillar Blast—will also be added to the Exchange Shop.

※The appearance of the Void -Strike- Series will be the same as the original Void Series.

----------------------------------------------------------------

◆ Gargoyle Triple Release & Dungeon Boost! ◆
To commemorate the release of the Void -Strike- Series, a special campaign will be held with the simultaneous release of three Gargoyle -Purgatorium- dungeons and a Dungeon Boost!
During the event, the stamina cost of eligible dungeons will be reduced, and item drop rates from monsters will be increased by 100%!
※For details on the simultaneous release of the three Gargoyle -Purgatorium- dungeons, please check below.

■ Eligible Dungeon Boost Targets
Assault! Infernal Gargoyle
Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle
Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle
Assault! Crag Gargoyle
Assault! Infernal Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Crag Gargoyle (Reward UP)
Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Puragtorium-
Assault! Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-
Assault! Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium-

※Lucky Box and clear reward drop rates will not be affected by this campaign’s increased drop rates.
※During the campaign period, daily dungeons will be available every day.
※Only drop rate boosts will apply in Yomotsuhirasaka - Winds and Yomotsuhirasaka - Lightning.

In addition, the same Vanguard characters who have bonus effects in the currently running Dungeon Boost Part 2 will also receive special attack bonuses in the eligible dungeons!

【Bonus Characters】
Izuna, Izuna Three-Tails, Dark Musashi, Uesugi Kenshin, Takeda Shingen
Sasaki Kojirou, Kojirou (Flying Swallow), Ibaraki Douji - Summer Sky, Murasaki Shikibu

■ Unlocking Purgatorium Dungeons
Players must clear the [To Kishinden] quest and speak to the NPC Chifuri
in the Temporal Rift in order to unlock these dungeons.

----------------------------------------------------------------

◆ Upcoming Update Plans ◆
After the simultaneous release of the three Gargoyle -Purgatorium- dungeons ends, we plan to make these dungeons permanently available after a certain period.

When they become permanent, the current [Purgatorium Treasures] dropped will be changed to new items, and adjustments will be made to the required exchange amounts. With this adjustment, the number of items required for some exchanges may increase compared to the current Purgatorium Treasures. We kindly ask for your understanding.

Additionally, weapons crafted from Abyss Gargoyle and Lucifer will also receive rebirth updates in future patches.
We also plan to make balance adjustments to certain other items.
Please look forward to it!


[hr][/hr]
・Gargoyle -Purgatorium- Triple Release!
To commemorate the release of the Void -Strike- Series, three Purgatorium Dungeons Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Purgatorium- ,Assault!Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-,  Assault!Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium- will appear in the Purgatorium Dungeons.
In these dungeons, you can obtain not only regular items but also exclusive items such as Purgatorium Treasure.

■ About Purgatorium Dungeons
・Monsters in these dungeons have high elemental resistances, making it difficult to damage them with non-weakness elements. Their HP and attack power are also significantly strengthened.
・Clearing a Purgatorium Dungeon with a B Rank or higher will reward you with Purgatorium Treasure.
・When clearing the dungeon on the “God” difficulty, there is a very small chance to obtain powerful Magatama.

■ Materials obtainable from Assault! Infernal Gargoyle -Purgatorium-
・From the boss Infernal Gargoyle of this dungeon, the following materials can drop:
　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle’s Fang
　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle’s Hand
　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Infernal Gargoyle’s Nucleus

■ Materials obtainable from Assault!Sleetsword Gargoyle -Purgatorium-
・From the boss Sleet Gargoyle of this dungeon, the following materials can drop:
　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Fang
　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Hand
　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Sleet Gargoyle’s Nucleus

■ Materials obtainable from Assault!Levinlance Gargoyle -Purgatorium-
・From the boss Levin Gargoyle of this dungeon, the following materials can drop:
　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Fang
　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Hand
　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Levin Gargoyle’s Nucleus

■ About Purgatorium Treasure
・Purgatorium Treasure can be exchanged for various items with the NPC Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo.
・This NPC becomes available after clearing each of the following dungeon difficulties once: Jin, Kō, and Shin.
・Purgatorium Exchange Rokudo only appears while the Purgatorium Dungeons are active, and the exchange lineup changes depending on which dungeons are available.
・After the Purgatorium Dungeon event period ends, Purgatorium Treasure will transform into an item called Purgatorium Junk.
　When the Purgatorium Dungeons return in the future, you can exchange multiple Purgatorium Junks for Purgatorium Treasures at the Exchange.

Update Information

New Assist Character Lady Daruma（VA：Momozono Riel）  will be added!

Lady Daruma is a character that supports Wind, Mountain, and Slash elements while also possessing a skill that protects players from Stun!

Details can be found here.
New Character Lady Daruma Added!

You can obtain Covenant Scroll - Lady Daruma to recruit Lady Daruma from the Lady Daruma Nyankoropon in the Shopping Plaza!
Additionally, it can also be obtained by exchanging 120 Yorozu Limited Tickets at the Yorozu Exchange NPC.

[hr][/hr]
・New Nyankoropon Added!

■Lady Daruma Nyankoropon
Covenant Scroll - Lady Daruma and Accessory Laddy Daruma will be added!

■Assist Nyankoropon!
A Nyankoropon featuring only assist characters in the Platinum slot!
Mini character accessories are also included in the lineup!

■Japanese Room Nyankoropon
A Nyankoropon where you can obtain furniture to decorate your My Room.
Items like the Irori Table and Calming Lantern are included in the lineup!

■Avater Nyankoropon Updated
Avatars such as Dancer Clarity Set and Bandit are making a comeback!

~Synopsis~
The protagonist meets a worried Servant Daruma on Onigashima.
They find Chief Daruma’s daughter, but Lady Daruma has her own reasons for not returning... 
What could be holding her back?

Talk to Servant Daruma in Onigashima in order to undertake this event quest.
※In order to undertake this quest it is a requirement that the player has cleared the [To Kishinden] main story quest prior.

----------------------------------------------------------------

Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue where changing equipment other than certain buff-granting magatama or items caused buff icons to display multiple times.

・To address an issue where equipment sets may not switch properly during skill cooldowns, the following changes will be implemented:
　● Equipment sets can no longer be switched while a skill is on cooldown.
　●The [Discard All] button in the equipment window will be disabled during skill cooldowns.

・Fixed an issue where equipment could not be changed in dungeons where equipment changes should be allowed.

・Fixed an issue where some of the exchange items for "Housing Exchange Ticket - Golden Glitter Series" were incorrect.
　Incorrect：Red Carpet Flooring
　Correct：Gold Tatami Flooring
　No item conversion or retrieval will be performed even if "Red Carpet Flooring" was previously exchanged.

・Fixed an issue where the skills "Secret Arts: Punishment Cross" (used by the Vanguard character Kirigakure Saizou) and "Punishment Cross" (used by the player) would not function correctly when activated near a wall or similar obstruction.

・An issue has been identified where the monster "Cursect Princess" in the dungeon "Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-" may not appear properly.
　This issue is believed to occur when using the Vanguard character Kirigakure Saizou's skill "Secret Arts: Punishment Cross" or the player's skill "Cross Punishment."As a temporary measure, knockback against "Cursect Princess" will be disabled.

・Fixed an issue for certain monsters such as [Lunar Spirit Kaguya-Hime] and [Cursect Princess], item acquisition status may not be displayed correctly in the system log or item pouch when the Auto Pickup feature is enabled.
　Please note that the items have been correctly processed on the server, and the proper acquisition status has been updated upon exiting the dungeon everytime.
　This issue has been present since the implementation of the Auto Pickup feature. 

・Other details have also been adjusted.

[Addendum]
・Fixed an issue where changing accessories or magatamas during a skill's cooldown would not apply the equipment change correctly.

notes.title: Announcement of the Beta Release of the 32-bit Version of Onigiri
notes.notes:
Greeting from Onigiri Management Team.

During the maintenance on Thursday, 5/30/2024 JST, we transitioned the Steam version of  "Onigiri" to a 64-bit client. However, we have encountered an issue where the game does not launch when the "Play" button is pressed in the Steam client.
As a temporary measure to address this issue,we have released a 32-bit beta version of  "Onigiri"。

If the issue is not resolved even after trying the solutions provided in the notice below, please switch to the 32-bit beta version of "Onigiri" and try launching the game.

Regarding the issue where the game client does not start:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/290470/view/4181108468552220236

[hr][/hr]
■How to switch to 32-bit beta version
①Right-click on "Onigiri" in Steam library to open the "Properties" screen.

②"Betas" → Select "32bit - onigiri 32bit" from the "Beta Participation" dropdown options to download 32-bit beta version.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/4468db5f29fe198e5d98781db964c2fb8471cf3f.png

※Select "None" from the "Beta Participation" dropdown options to revert your game to the 64-bit version.
※Bith the 32-bit and 64-bit versions use the same game database. There are no differences in game progress or obtained items.

[hr][/hr]
If the issue persists even after trying the above solutions, please report it via the inquiry form on the Onigiri's Steam official website.

Onigiri's Steam official website
https://crossplay.onigiri.cyberstep.com/


We are going to continue to investigate this issue to ensure that more users can play the 64-bit version.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

・A Stamina Restoration Panel will be added.

　●If Stamina exceeds the natural recovery limit, the recovery time will not be displayed.

■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.

　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

　・The Dragon Ark Aosame Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Uryuu's Dagger
　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Uryuu's Fittings
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Uryuu's Amethyst

■Concerning Purgatorium Treasures
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 9/14/2023 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
Update Information
・The status effects Poison and Burn will no longer cause damage when HP falls to 0, but will cause damage if HP is at 1.
　In accordance with this change, Sesshu's main combo attack [Blood Bloom] and [Warbrush Ougi: Withered Bamboo] will confer damage in the same fashion.

・The following changes will be made to the descriptions of [Bonus Damage] and [Critical Bonus Damage] in buff and weapon options to make them easier to understand.
　Upper damage limit will also be listed.
　　Bonus Damage Example)
　　Before Change：A bonus of 1 damage is dealt depending on the value of Fire Element during a critical hit, at a rate of 50%. ※Damage cap cannot be exceeded
　　After Change：50% chance of adding 100% of damage dealt as Fire Element damage ※Damage Limit 1,000,000
　　Critical Bonus Damage Example)
　　Before Change：Deals 1 additional damage on critical hit according to Fire Element values *Limit to Damage Added
　　After Change：On critical hit, 100% of the damage dealt is added to total damage as Fire Element ※Damage Limit 1,000,000
　In accordance with this change, Sesshu's Skill Warbrush Ougi: Inner Paradise will have the text description edited.

・For Sesshu, special effects will now be added to damage for [Blood Bloom] and [Warbrush Ougi: Withered Bamboo].

[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes
・Corrects an issue where the upper damage limit for Sesshu's skill [Warbrush Ougi: Inner Paradise] was not as intended.
　Before edit：Max 1,000,000
　After edit：Max 5,000,000

・Fixed an issue where Sesshu's vanguard replacement gauge increase amount was incorrect at Awakening LV5.
　Before Change：Vanguard Gauge Increase＋200％
　After Change：Vanguard Gauge Increase＋400％

・Fixed an issue where the Sake would disappear when the Sesshu's vanguard swap was cancelled.

・Corrected an issue where Sesshu would visually dissapear when the Ink Gauge ran low while the skill [Warbrush: Petals] was active.

・Fixed an issue where the dungeon portal for [the Treasure Hunt! Battle on the Abandoned Island!] event would appear on Onigashima field.

・An issue where players who had refilled their Sake with [Benten's Blessing] or [Moth Orchid] before the 8/24/2023 JST maintenance could not log in has been corrected.
　※Players affected by this issue will have compensation sent at a later date. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
　[Addendum]
　We will also investigate the status of the achievement and send compensation items  at a later date.

・Fixed an issue where Amakusa Shiro's feet clipped through the ground in the [That Which Is Precious] event field [Mountain Forest Depths].

[Addendum and Revisions]
・The [That Which Is Precious] Event Dungeon had lower than intended drop rates of the [Mysterious Metal Fragment] on Hard and Hell difficulties.
　To adjust for this, the number of Mysterious Metal Fragments required for the exchange will be changed.
　※Characters who have already made exchanges requiring the Mysterious Metal Fragments will be compensated the number of fragments making the difference in exchange rate.
　　Supplementary items will also be sent contingent on the number of dungeon clears. We sincerely apologize for this issue.
　Additionally, we will be adding [the Unusual Metal Fragment Basket] at the bottom of the exchange, which will  allow players to exchange for the [Strange Metal Fragment] and [Bizarre Metal Fragment] items.

・For Sesshu, the notation fluctuation of the skill descriptions have been corrected and adjusted to make them easier to read.

[hr][/hr]

・New Nyankoropon Added!！

Nyankoropon details can be found here.

　After maintenance 9/7/2023 JST
　Until maintenance 9/21/2023 JST

・Murasaki Shikibu Swimsuit Pack Added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/62ac43e33092291ba3187983c09bb9287a6632c8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3f319d7bc671daf0dea7d04509d8986434970710.jpg

A Swimsuit Outfit Change Pack for Murasaki Shikibu will be reissued!

This Swimsuit Packs will be available at the Shopping Plaza
and include one Swimuit Outfit Change and the following items.
This Pack will cost 200 paid OC each and will be limited to one purchase.


■Pack Contents
　・Outfit Change Swimsuit x1
　・Limited Gacha Ticket x5
　・Smelting Amulet Transcendent Fortune x1
　・Oranmentation Amulet Transcendent Fortune x1
　・Max Durability +500 Ticket x1


◆Swimsuit Pack Sale Period
　After maintenance 9/7/2023 JST
　Until maintenance 9/21/2023 JST

[hr][/hr]
・Purgatorium Dungeon Added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/8af9028c41d2f497dfa786b5a1b8f26fed0c8f23.jpg

During the event period, the warding dungeon [Assault! Dragon Ark Gakuhou -Puragtorium-] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

■Concerning Purgatorium Dungeons
　・The monsters have high resistances, and attacks other than super effective attacks will be less effective.
　　Additionally, these monsters will have extra strong attacks.
　・Clear the dungeon with a B Rank or higher to be awarded Purgatorium Treasures.
　・Occasionally when clearing at the highest difficulty, you can get a rare Magatama!

■About Items from the Dragon Ark Tenshou Purgatorium dungeon
　・The Dragon Ark Tenshou Purgatorium Boss will drop the following items:

　　　Normal Difficulty → Purgatorium Houryuu's Dagger
　　　Hard Difficulty → Purgatorium Houryuu's Fittings
　　　Hell Difficulty → Purgatorium Houryuu's Emerald

■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/a19a3f504b564c12ab666d4f4106c55baf47bb0b.jpg

Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.
The details of the 8/17/2023 JST update are as follows:

[hr][/hr]
Update Information
・In Yoshitsune's [Weapon Enhancement] screen, the [Approve] button on the enhancement screen will be changed to a [Skip] button.
　Pressing the [Skip] button will skip the enhancement effect and the final enhancement gauge and the [Accep] button will be displayed.

・The sorting specs on the [Friends] screen will be changed as follows.
　・The sort conditions will be saved. ※Saved to the client.
　・The [Status] tab will sort characters by Online/Offline status,
　　and characters without established friends will be sorted to the bottom.
　・Under the [Approval] tab, characters will be sorted by Approved > Waiting for Approval > Waiting for Approval/Rejection
　・If all conditions are the same characters will be sorted by date of creation.

[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue where effects which slowed enemies' movements did not function properly.

・Fixed an issue where the set wallpaper and flooring in MyRoom would not apply correctly under certain circumstances has been fixed.

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your attention!
※Update details are liable to change without warning and may not reflect in-game.

Thank you for your support for Onigiri!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/5b62aee6832169c20c42f0059480194f3d688c1a.jpg
During the event period, the warding dungeon [Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-] will be available.
Purgatorium dungeons appear irregularly, but you can get the exclusive Purgatorium Treasure items!

■Concerning Purgatorium Treasure
・Purgatorium treasures can be exchanged with the purgatorium treasure NPC in Onigashima.
・Clear each difficulty of the Purgatorium dungeon once in order to open the Exchange.
・The purgatorium treasure NPC is only available when the purgatorium dungeon is available, and the items
available in the exchange vary depending on which purgatorium is available.
・Purgatorium treasures will convert to purgatorium junk when the purgatorium dungeon is no longer available, but 
the purgatorium junk can be exchanged for treasures with the NPC.

■About Items from the [Assault! Cursect Princess -Puragtorium-] dungeon
　・The following items will be dropped from the boss monster Cursect Princess.

　　　Normal Difficulty → Cursect Gossamer Wings
　　　Hard Difficulty → Cursect Armored Jaw
　　　Hell Difficulty → Cursect Poison Needle

In addition, you can get new weapon recipes as a drop item from the Cursect Princess!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/01030f73838074b8c0420a205832ae0959cd40e4.png

Additionally, players who clear the Hell and  Oni  difficulty a number of times can receive certain achievement awards!

▼About the Exchange Lineup
[Cursect Killer Recipe]
[Cursect Killer - Metamorphosis Recipe]
[Cursect Magatama recipe]

Look forward to many other great items as well!

[hr][/hr]
・[Dressed Up to Go Out] Event Begins!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/c49116f274be292896630730869e6252ef79e1cc.jpg

Challenge Chifuri's Warding Dungeons in order to obtain Nirvana Grapes, which can be given to The NPC Yukari in order to spin the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon!
Collect 2 Nirvana Grapes to spin the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon once, or 20 of them to spin the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon 10 times.

The Treasure Chest has a fixed number of prizes, and once those prizes are out of stock they can be reset a certain number of times.
Resetting the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon will reset the stock of all of the prizes at once so that they can be won again.

In addition, players can obtain 「Item Ticket - Dressed Up to Go Out」 from the Treasure Chest Nyankoropon which can be used to redeem Shakokidogu furnitures.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/83999d61726441420e4b88738af4ea537b0fb6e6.png
　「Shakokidogu Earth」
　「Shakokidogu Ocean」
　「Shakokidogu Volcano」
　「Shakokidogu Cave」
　「Shakokidogu Desert」

※The Treasure Chest Nyankoropon can be reset 11 times and no more.
※No Drop Rate boosting items or effect will affect the drop rate of he Nirvana Grape in Purgatorium Dungeons.
※Difference between player and monster level will not affect drop rate.
※Items will drop from monsters which have been defeated by party members as well.

notes.title: 8/10 Update Contents
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Onigiri service team.

The contents of the August 10th 2021 JST Update Maintenance are as follows.

[hr][/hr]
・New Character Murakami III Added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/7e51906e22a58b90b4d6b72c70355ba318b5dba4.png
The new Vanguard character Captain Murakami III has been added!

Murakami III has a new feature, the Possession Gauge.
The Possession Gauge charges when Murakami makes regular attacks.
Murakami can trigger special attacks by using the possession gauge.

■Actions consuming the Possession Gauge
1. Special Artillery
Click the Guard key and Normal Attack buttons to activate this skill.
This technique is a non-elemental attack that ignores the enemy attribute resistance.
It consumes a small amount of Possession Gauge when activated.
* A certain number of Possession gauges are required to activate the skill.

2. Ghostly Possession
Click the Guard key and Skill Attack buttons to activate this skill.
After activating the skill, the exclusive buff "possession" activates and grants the following effects:

・HP is fixed at 1 regardless of damage received during effect's duration
・ Increased attack power
・ Increased damage limit

Also, after the possession buff wears off, normal HP recovery will not resume, so
 items and skills must be used to recover HP.
* You can use it only once during a dungeon.
* It can be activated 10 seconds after the vanguard change.
* To activate, the possession Gauge must be fully stocked.
* All possession Gauges are consumed upon activation.

Use these special skills to unleash torment upon your enemies with this new vanguard!

You can obtain Summoning Scrolls for Murakami III from the new Nyankoropon, 
or the Yorozu Exchange with new Summer Limited Exchange Ticket 2021.

notes.title: 11/24 Update Information
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Onigiri Service Team.

The contents of the 11/24 update are as follows.

New Character Added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ae061d745a978f0a599bd14a9136dbbe7765696f.png

The new vanguard character, Yorimitsu, Defender of the Imperial Family, has been added!

About Yorimitsu
Yorimitsu uses a Burst Gauge System, which will be visible on the 
bottom right of the screen during Vanguard Swap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/0f9b6d5b14a7aa37506de406ddb897b0f89ee795.png

The Burst Gauge will be charged when using Skills or Ougi,
and charging the Gauge completely will give the player access to special skills!

Using Clashing Heavens will give the player buffs and increase Ougi strength.
The Burst Gauge will expire after a certain amount of time, but the duration
can be increased by attacking or using a Perfect Guard.

Moreover, while in Burst Mode, using Clashing Heavens
results in a beautiful dance of blades!
Doing so will expend all of the Burst Gauge, so be careful!

Using Awakenings for Yorimitsu will grant skill and equipable weapon bonuses,
and even new costumes as well!

At Awakening Lv1, Yorimitsu can use sword skills,
But at awakening Lv3 she can use Twin Sword and Bow skills,
and at Lv5 she can use Oodachi skills!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/ec327561960e9f34539dc3c5bd813b93a2ab7cec.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/3463f1f1b7d0699b1f31b6b89a71969a44f35ff9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603612/cd6d0476d9362c04f7d74ab6fa4cee66aec2749f.png
